title: Barnegat Lighthouse, Atlantic Ocean, New Jersey
creator: Carol M. Highsmith
description: Barnegat Light was commissioned on January 1, 1859. The tower light was 165 feet above sea level and the lighthouse itself was four times taller than the original. The new light was a first-order flashing Fresnel lens, which stood about 12 feet tall. The current lighthouse is really two towers in one: the exterior conical tower covers a cylindrical tower on the inside. Title, date, subject note, and keywords provided by the photographer. title: Point Vicente Light, Rancho Palos Verdes, California
creator: Carol M. Highsmith
description: Before the installation of lighthouses on the Pacific coast, many ships and seamen went to their graves on its rocky schoals. Shipmasters deplored this dangerous stretch of coastal water. On May 1, 1926 their petitions were answered when the U.S. Lighthouse Service began the operation of Point Vicente Lighthouse. The 1000 watt bulb, focused through a five foot lens, could be seen over twenty miles. Gift and purchase; Carol M. Highsmith; 2011; (DLC/PP-2011:124). Forms part of: Carol M.
